observations.text: Reassessment scope and tree state. argv git status --porcelain, exit 0, stdout empty, stderr empty: HEAD 711498db5e420b647751268e92e4f275701b2ddf is clean, so every judged byte is the committed byte. Selection is mechanical, not memory-picked: argv git diff --stat 54a363d HEAD, exit 0, 12 files changed, 1483 insertions, 142 deletions. Exactly three of them are code or test: crates/foundry-acceptance/tests/features/instance-integration-setup.feature (+24, the E17 oracle scenario inserted at 1368-1390, no existing line touched), crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/handlers/secrets_key.rs (52 changed) and crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/secrets_key_rotation.rs (43 changed). The other nine are generated or recorded documents (acceptance.md/html, architecture.html, brief.html, handoff.json, runs/craft.S3.json, runs/review.oracle.S1-S3.json). argv git diff --stat 0068420 HEAD -- crates xtask scripts, exit 0, stdout empty: no code or test byte changed after the fix commit, so a native result taken at 0068420 applies unchanged at HEAD. No step file, no support file and no fixture changed in the delta: the new scenario is composed entirely of step regexes that already existed (steps/feature_instance_integration_setup.rs lines 95, 102, 285, 586, 729, 744, 670, 756), so no support byte was softened to admit it.

Project test-impact port tool: still absent within a bound. argv timeout -k 5 60 code-fact impacted-tests crates/foundry-acceptance/tests/features/instance-integration-setup.feature crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/handlers/secrets_key.rs crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/secrets_key_rotation.rs --root /Users/jeffbailey/Projects/canzan/foundry, exit 124 (killed at the bound), stdout empty, stderr empty. No selection was returned, so selection fell back to the repository declared verification commands for the touched paths: the us-iis-07 acceptance lane for the feature file and the two handler/domain files, and cargo xtask smoke (fmt, clippy --all-targets --release -D warnings, xtask check-arch, cargo test --workspace --exclude foundry-acceptance --release) for the two Rust files. This records an absent tool, not a pass.

Reused native result, not re-executed: cargo xtask smoke. Operator: the review host. argv timeout -k 30 5400 scripts/test-in-lima.sh cargo xtask smoke, exit 0, stdout ends xtask smoke :: all gates green, log /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-jeffbailey-Projects-canzan-foundry/ae6f0864-8ca5-43d5-b970-fb78c37ae831/scratchpad/smoke-e17-fix.log, taken on a tree whose code bytes are identical to 0068420 and therefore to HEAD (argv git diff --stat 0068420 HEAD -- crates xtask scripts printed nothing, exit 0). Read from xtask/src/main.rs run_smoke, that one run covers the four S3 verification commands other than the acceptance lane: xtask check-arch, the foundry-app library tests including integrations::secrets_key_rotation, the foundry-store test iis_instance_store, plus cargo fmt --check and clippy -D warnings over all targets. Clippy green over all targets is also the evidence that the replaced boolean helper left no dead code behind. Reuse waives no check: the one check smoke excludes, foundry-acceptance, I executed myself.

Check I executed on the reviewed commit: the us-iis-07 acceptance lane. argv timeout -k 30 590 scripts/test-in-lima.sh bash -c (source scripts/eip-lanes.sh; eip_warm; eip_lane us-iis-07), run once in the shared local-dev Lima VM, exit 0. stdout ends: 1 feature, 30 scenarios (30 passed), 532 steps (532 passed), exited with code 0; stderr was folded into the same log, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-jeffbailey-Projects-canzan-foundry/ae6f0864-8ca5-43d5-b970-fb78c37ae831/scratchpad/reviewer-lane-us-iis-07.711498d.log. Count comparison against the recorded RED of the same lane at 7e1f9c5 (30 scenarios, 29 passed, 1 failed, 527 steps, 526 passed, 1 failed): the same 30 scenarios, five more steps all passing, nothing skipped, nothing removed. The producer claim of 30/30 in runs/craft.S3.json is now an observed fact of this candidate, not a report.

The E17 oracle scenario discriminates, observed both ways on candidate-bound runs. RED at 7e1f9c5, log lane-e17-red.log lines 786-807: the scenario While this Foundry opens its secrets key, a start over confirmed from a tab left open changes nothing failed on Then Priya reads her answer is this Foundry integrations page, with the captured output showing POST /admin/instance/integrations/secrets-key/start-over answering 200 text/html with the I-28 cost question and its count of 2, and the live Start over control on it. GREEN at HEAD, my own lane log lines 513-538: the same 24 steps pass, including nothing Priya reads there says the cost question, Priya is offered no way to start over, the stored secrets key and the Activity are as they were, Canzan Labs saved Slack connection still opens, and the saved Slack app still in effect with its secrets and activity unchanged. The stimulus is genuinely the stale tab: support/instance_integration_setup.rs choose_on_start_over_page reuses the start-over page the scenario is already holding when its path is the start-over door, and the RED proves the POST was reached rather than the page re-fetched. Assertions are read through the public pages plus the declared test seam for the stored key, the Activity list and the replica config version (then_nothing_replaced), none of them tautological: each one failed or would fail on the recorded wrong behaviour.

Design judgment of the two production files, reviewer_reason, against nw-code-design-oo and Dimension 4. The decision what a confirmed start over does now has exactly one owner: UnopenableOffer::confirmed_post in integrations/secrets_key_rotation.rs:207-217 maps the three offer states onto the new pure sum ConfirmedStartOver (Applies, AsksAgain, NotOffered), and handlers/secrets_key.rs:452-456 only matches its cases. The boolean that restated the same fact, startable, is gone, replaced by offered() returning the domain value itself (handlers/secrets_key.rs:561-570), so the page link, the confirm page and the POST read one answer and cannot disagree: that disagreement was exactly E17. The new type is not a duplicate carrier of UnopenableOffer: it names what the POST does, keeps that naming out of the handler where the defect lived, and every arm is read by a stated outcome (Applies by the committed start over, AsksAgain by the live-replica scenario, NotOffered by the new E17 scenario). StartOverCost::Again narrowed from an unconditional true to UnopenableOffer::reads_gate(key_mode, key_file) (handlers/secrets_key.rs:505-511), which keeps the refusal page where the replica gate is what withholds the way out; the live-replica arm still reaches it, confirmed by the lane scenario A start over confirmed after another Foundry server speaks again discards nothing passing. Totality, exhaustive matches, no else, no primitive carrying a domain meaning, no getter, no new state, dependencies pointing inward (the domain type knows nothing of the handler answer type). No over-engineering: no flag, option or extension point the delta adds is unread. No test was weakened, narrowed or skipped anywhere in the delta.

Residual states and non-blocking notes, neither of them a defect of this delta. First, the NotOffered arm is reached by five states (a stored key this Foundry opens, I-27, I-31, an instance key file withheld with no operator key, and a gate that could not be read). The new scenario observes the first through the public port; the other four get the same single total decision from the same pure function, and the Request declares no POST behaviour of its own for them, so representative coverage plus the exhaustive match is sufficient and I raise no oracle gap. The delta also silently improves the withheld-key-file state, which before it drew the cost page from the StartOverCost::Again arm. Second, the acceptance.md and handoff.json row added for the new scenario cites it as feature:1375 plus title, where every other row of the same file cites feature::title with no line number; that locator fragility is already recorded as an open oracle-owned finding inside runs/review.oracle.S3.json and accepted there at 758f6d3, so I do not duplicate it as a finding of this subject. It blocks nothing and changes no observation above.

Capability limit: typesafe unavailable. I formed three reviewer-owned questions over a redacted compact state (oracle discrimination of the delta scenario against the recorded wrong behaviour as a Choice, invariant ownership of the new sum type as a Score, and scope discipline of the delta as a Noul) and invoked the authorized client from a shell command: argv python /Users/jeffbailey/.claude/skills/nw-typesafe-system-one/scripts/jev_decide.py --request - --output - with the request on stdin and no file written, exit 3, stdout: typesafe unavailable, TYPESAFE_API_KEY is absent from this process environment. No judgment was returned and none is invented. All three questions were therefore answered locally against the original evidence, and their answers are the observations above. No producer-owned judgment was consumed.

diagnostic: Accepted. The E17 delta 54a363d..HEAD is three code or test files over a clean HEAD 711498d; everything else in it is generated or recorded documents. The product violation the source-blind examiner found is closed at its cause, not at its symptom: the decision what a confirmed start over does is now owned by one pure total function on the domain type that already owned the offer (UnopenableOffer::confirmed_post onto the new sum ConfirmedStartOver), the boolean that let the page and the POST disagree is gone, and the handler only matches the cases. The refusal page is kept exactly where the live-replica gate is the reason the way out is withheld. No test was weakened, narrowed, skipped or removed, no step or support byte changed, and the one scenario the delta adds is the recorded oracle approved at 758f6d3. Evidence is candidate-bound and sufficient: I executed the one check the reused native smoke excludes, argv timeout -k 30 590 scripts/test-in-lima.sh bash -c (source scripts/eip-lanes.sh; eip_warm; eip_lane us-iis-07), exit 0, 30 scenarios all passed, 532 steps all passed, against the recorded RED of the same lane at 7e1f9c5 whose one failure was the exact falsifier (the POST answering the I-28 cost page with a count of 2 on a Foundry whose key opens); and I reuse the host run of cargo xtask smoke, exit 0, all gates green, taken on a tree whose code bytes are identical to HEAD, which carries fmt, clippy over all targets, check-arch, the foundry-app library tests and the foundry-store iis_instance_store test. No finding of any owner. Two limits stand on the record and block nothing: the project test-impact port tool code-fact impacted-tests returned nothing within a 60 second bound (exit 124, empty output), so selection fell back to the declared verification commands for the touched paths; and Jev was unavailable (exit 3, TYPESAFE_API_KEY absent), so my three reviewer-owned questions were answered locally against the original evidence and no judgment was invented.
